headline: MIN @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 4.29 at HOU 4.95, with a projected total of 9.24. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (MIN -0.25, HOU -0.14), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.40, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +19.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Peter Lambert has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Isaac Paredes, Trevor Larnach, Jeremy Peña, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jake Meyers because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
